content: FreetoShop is a browser-only, local-first editor under phased development with npm workspaces including apps/web, packages/core-document, command-history, compositor, renderer, raster-engine, selection-engine, filter-engine, transform-engine, text-engine, file-codecs, persistence, benchmarks, and pixel-storage. The task is a sustained engineering effort to implement professional editing workflows, starting with Milestone 1: Clone Stamp foundation. The architecture preserves tiled/pixel storage, selection/mask/channel handling, copy-on-write behavior, undoable transactions, and existing Brush/Eraser workflows. The repository was inspected showing apps/web/src with editor, tools, panels, shell, components, commands, workers; packages with core-document, compositor, renderer, raster-engine, selection-engine, filter-engine, transform-engine, text-engine, file-codecs, persistence, pixel-storage, command-history, benchmarks; and docs with architecture, document model, benchmarks, performance evidence. Key architectural boundaries: apps/web owns interaction/accessibility/PWA/view state; core-document owns serializable editor state, layer ordering, affine transforms, TiledPixelStore/TiledCoverageStore; command-history owns undo/redo; compositor owns blend modes and composition; renderer turns document/viewport into Canvas 2D pixels without mutating document. The Clone Stamp tool requires Alt/Option-click source establishment, aligned/unaligned modes, coordinate mapping, selection/mask respect, atomic undoable transactions, persistence, and explicit testable data model. The raster-engine exposes deterministic, sparse-aware painting and adjustment primitives that operate on TiledPixelStore/TiledCoverageStore without full-layer densification. Key functions: resizeLayer/resizeImage (with document-scale transform propagation, mask/channel resampling, working-set byte caps, and MAX_RESIZE_WORKING_BYTES enforcement); paintMaskStroke/paintStroke (interpolated dabs, localDabBounds, falloff/hardness/opacity/pressure, selectionCoverage, reveal/conceal or source-over/erase modes, returning minimal PixelPatch/CoveragePatch); adjustBrightness/adjustBrightnessPixelStore (selection-bounded or full-layer edits, invertible transform validation, sparse selection densification only); plus helpers (multiplyTransforms, scalePathCommand, selectionCoverage, unionBounds, documentDabBounds, readSelectionRegion, makePatchFromRegion, compositeSourceOver, dabCoverage, coverageStoreBounds, layerBoundsFromDocumentBounds). Validation covers layer/selection/raster-mask dimensions, transform invertibility, finite/unit constraints, and brush/color channel contracts. The assistant continued by scheduling further reads of raster-engine, core-document, and command-history entry points.

The assistant registered the clone stamp tool in the tool registry (toolRegistry.ts) by adding a 'cloneStamp' entry with label 'Clone Stamp Tool', icon 'clone', family 'cloneStamp', slot 12, and shortcut 'S'. It then added the missing 'clone' icon to Icon.tsx (ICON_NAMES and paths). Next, it implemented the clone stamp painting function in the raster-engine package (packages/raster-engine/src/index.ts). The first edit added a placeholder paintCloneStamp function with CloneStampOptions (size, hardness, opacity, aligned) and a comment-filled implementation that returned an empty patch. The second edit rewrote CloneStampOptions to include sourceX/sourceY and replaced the function body with a proper implementation: validating inputs, converting the source position to source layer local space, interpolating points into dabs with aligned/unaligned offset logic, and preparing to sample from the source layer and write to the destination layer (the edit was cut off mid-function).

The clone stamp tool was registered in toolRegistry.ts with label 'Clone Stamp Tool', icon 'clone', family 'cloneStamp', slot 12, and shortcut 'S', and the 'clone' icon was added to Icon.tsx. The paintCloneStamp function in packages/raster-engine/src/index.ts was implemented with CloneStampOptions (size, hardness, opacity, aligned, sourceX, sourceY) and a full implementation: input validation, source position conversion to source layer local space, point interpolation into dabs with aligned/unaligned offset logic, stroke bounds computation, selection-aware sampling, alpha compositing of source pixels onto the destination, and changed-bounds tracking. An earlier edit attempt failed because the old text did not match the file exactly; a subsequent read confirmed the function was already present in the file with the same implementation. The next planned steps are updating ToolOptionsBar to show clone stamp options, adding unit tests, and updating the tool registry test.

The next planned steps remain updating ToolOptionsBar to show clone stamp options, adding unit tests, and updating the tool registry test.

The current state is that ToolOptionsBar now renders clone stamp options, the tool registry test was updated to include cloneStamp, and the next planned steps remain adding clone stamp unit tests and updating the tool registry test (already addressed). No separate confirmation that the full suite now passes after the test update is present in the supplied events.
